data.name: Pain Blast
data.description: Once per round as a free action, a bone devil can stimulate extreme pain in one creature within its reach. The creature takes a -4 penalty on attack rolls, skill checks, and ability checks until the start of the devil's next turn or until it moves at least 60 feet away from the devil.
